share.title: Name Compatibility Test

about.text1: Name compatibility draws from the cultural science of onomastics (the study of names) and phonosemantics (sound symbolism). Across global cultures—from traditional East Asian stroke-count compatibility to Western phonetic euphony—names carry distinctive rhythmic patterns and acoustic frequencies that evoke playful intuitive associations.
about.text2: In relationship psychology, name matching operates as a projective conversation starter. Exploring compatibility scores gives couples and friends a lighthearted pretext to discuss core relational pillars: emotional intimacy, communication styles, mutual trust, and future aspirations.
about.faq1Q: What linguistic and cultural traditions inspire name compatibility tests?
about.faq1A: Name compatibility combines cultural onomastics, phonetic sound symbolism, and traditional stroke-count counting games. The algorithm translates characters into playful acoustic and numerical resonance scores.
about.faq2Q: Does name compatibility determine actual relationship success?
about.faq2A: No. Name match tests are playful cultural games and reflective conversational prompts. Genuine romantic compatibility depends on mutual respect, active communication, shared values, and emotional maturity.
about.faq3Q: Are the names I enter stored or transmitted to external servers?
about.faq3A: Never. The name calculation algorithm executes 100% locally in your web browser. Neither your name nor your partner's name is ever sent across the network or stored in any database.
